operations.title: Norm splitting and invariant-defect detection have three arithmetic regimes
operations.statement: For ST=d id: units give splitting and detection; regular nonunits give detection without scalar splitting; d-torsion permits detection failure. Over Z, five-site degrees 2^k lie in the middle regime; in characteristic two they lie in the failure regime.

operations.title: Integral five-site degree separates detection from splitting
operations.procedure: Take d=2^k acting on a free integral chain module.
operations.outcome: Multiplication by d is injective, so S detects im T, but d is not a unit and (1/d)T is not integral.
operations.falsifier: This falsifies identifying failure of norm splitting with failure of invariant-defect detection.
